steps.title: Clone plasmids with dual fluorophores
steps.instruction: Insert the cDNA of the protein of interest and the standard proteins into pcDNA3 or pcDNA5/FRT/TO vectors, fusing mVenus and PAmCherry to the C‑terminus (or N‑terminus) of each protein; use a flexible linker of 10–30 amino acids and verify protein function after tagging.

steps.title: Clean coverslips with Piranha solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 32 mL of Piranha solution by adding 24 mL concentrated (95–97 %) sulfuric acid to a glass beaker with a magnetic stir bar, stir low speed, then slowly add 8 mL 30 % hydrogen peroxide while stirring; keep the beaker in a chemical fume hood, stir for ~3 min, pour the solution into a Coplin slide staining jar containing vertically positioned 25 mm coverslips, cover loosely and leave under a laminar hood for five days.

substeps.instruction: Place the coverslips in the Coplin jar so both sides are immersed.
Add a magnetic bar under the beaker before pouring to retain the stir bar.
After five days, add 50 mL water to the beaker while stirring, then slowly add 5 M NaOH to neutralize; confirm neutrality with pH indicator paper.
Transfer the neutralized solution to a sink.

Prepare an ice bath beaker at least 30 × the Piranha volume, pour the remaining Piranha solution onto the ice, stir slowly, let ice melt, then add NaOH pellets to neutralize; discard when pH neutral, cooled, and stabilized.
Rinse the coverslips in the Coplin jar with double‑distilled water 20 times, collecting the first three rinses in a beaker and neutralizing with NaOH before disposal.
Store the cleaned coverslips immersed in double‑distilled water in the same jar, seal with parafilm, and keep refrigerated.

steps.title: Culture and passage HEK293T cells
steps.instruction: Grow HEK293T cells in DMEM supplemented with 50 U/mL penicillin‑streptomycin and 10 % fetal bovine serum in 10 cm Petri dishes at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; passage at least once weekly and refresh medium every three days.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate medium from a 10 cm dish containing 10 mL medium.
Wash cells with 10 mL PBS three times and aspirate.
Add 1 mL 0.05 % Trypsin‑EDTA (pre‑warmed to 37 °C), spread, and incubate 1 min at 37 °C.
Shake gently to detach cells; add 9 mL pre‑warmed culture medium.
Resuspend the cell suspension by pipetting up and down 10 times to obtain a single‑cell suspension.
Transfer 1 mL of this suspension into a new 10 cm dish containing 10 mL fresh pre‑warmed medium, shake gently, and place in the incubator.
Repeat passages ten times until fresh thawed cells are used.

steps.title: Seed cells on cleaned coverslips
steps.instruction: Transfer a cleaned 25 mm coverslip into a 3.5 cm Petri dish using sterilized tweezers, add 2 mL warm culture medium, dispense 0.1 mL cell suspension onto the coverslip, swirl to distribute sparsely, and incubate 6 h in the incubator to allow cells to settle.

steps.title: Prepare DNA‑Lipofectamine mix
steps.instruction: In two autoclaved 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes add 100 µL OptiMEM each; to one tube add 1 µg plasmid DNA, to the other add 3 µL Lipofectamine 2000, incubate both tubes 5 min at room temperature, then slowly combine dropwise, incubate 20 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfect cells and incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Add the DNA‑Lipofectamine mixture dropwise to the 3.5 cm dish containing the settled cells, then return the dish to the incubator and incubate overnight.

steps.title: Fix cells with cold methanol
steps.instruction: After the overnight incubation, aspirate medium, wash cells gently five times with 2 mL filtered 0.22 µm PBS, add 2 mL methanol pre‑chilled to –20 °C, incubate 5 min at –20 °C, remove methanol, wash five times with 2 mL PBS, and keep the cells in PBS.

steps.title: Add fiducial beads to imaging chamber
steps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL of 100 nm TetraSpeck bead solution (vortexed) in 0.5 mL PBS, add the dilution to a custom‑made imaging chamber containing the fixed‑cell coverslip, seal, and place the chamber in a light‑proof box for 1 h at lab temperature (22 °C) to let beads settle.

steps.title: Prepare imaging buffer and warm system
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL PBS to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube, let it equilibrate to lab temperature, and simultaneously switch on the microscope system to warm for at least 30 min; align lasers and set intensities according to the example values (4.4 mW 514 nm, 5.4 mW 561 nm, 405 nm ramp 3.0 µW → 4.8 mW).

steps.title: Set camera and laser acquisition parameters
steps.instruction: Configure the camera for 50 ms exposure and 85.59 ms frame interval; ensure the stage temperature is stable at 22 °C and the lab is darkened or covered.

steps.title: Bleach impurities and record mVenus
steps.instruction: In widefield mode, turn on the 561 nm laser and acquire ~3,000 frames to bleach background impurities; then switch to TIRF mode and record 4,000 frames with the 514 nm laser for mVenus (extend by 2,000 frames if blinking persists).

steps.title: Record PAmCherry blinking events
steps.instruction: In TIRF mode, acquire 6,000–12,000 frames with the 561 nm laser while gradually increasing the 405 nm activation laser from 3.0 µW to 4.8 mW so that PAmCherry events are sparsely distributed; if blinking persists after 12,000 frames, expression is too high and laser power should be increased; discard any recording where axial drift exceeds 100 nm.

steps.title: Capture bead images for LCA correction
steps.instruction: Select a region on the coverslip without cells containing >10 beads, record 50 frames in the green channel and 50 frames in the red channel, shift the sample slightly and repeat; continue until at least 100 distinct bead positions are collected across the field of view.

steps.title: Prepare bead‑only sample
steps.instruction: Clean a 75 mm × 25 mm microscope slide with Piranha solution and air‑dry; vortex the TetraSpeck bead stock for 1 min, add 5 µL bead solution to 400 µL double‑distilled water, vortex, apply the diluted beads to a cleaned 25 mm coverslip and air‑dry at room temperature; place the coverslip bead‑side down on the slide, glue with 4–5 tiny drops of nail polish, let dry, and store the slide in the dark at room temperature.

steps.title: Image bead‑only sample
steps.instruction: Mount the bead slide in a magnetic chamber, let it stabilize for ~20 min, set acquisition parameters identical to the cell sample (pixel size, exposure, frame rate), reduce laser intensities to avoid over‑exposure, and record 50 frames in each of the green and red channels; repeat moving the sample until ~500 beads or positions are captured.

steps.title: Extract localizations with analysis software
steps.instruction: Use SNSMIL (or alternatively SMAP) to localize emission events from the recorded videos; follow the software’s standard workflow for generating localization tables.

steps.title: Prepare PBS buffer solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 8 g NaCl, 0.2 g KCl, 1.15 g Na₂HPO₄·2H₂O, and 0.2 g KH₂PO₄ in 500 mL double‑distilled water, bring the volume to 1 L, adjust pH to 7.3–7.4, filter through a 0.22 µm sterile filter, store in an autoclaved glass bottle at 4 °C.
